links.outcome: LLM gendered decisions and stereotypes probed via social determinants of health inputs in French patient records
links.effect: Embedded stereotypes could be probed using SDoH input, and LLMs relied on embedded stereotypes to make gendered decisions. No numeric results reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Through a series of experiments, we found that embedded stereotypes can be probed using SDoH input and that LLMs rely on embedded stereotypes to make gendered decisions, suggesting that evaluating interactions among SDoH factors could usefully complement existing approaches to assessing LLM performance and bias.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation probing bias and gender stereotypes in LLMs using French patient records and social determinants of health.
